newsitem.headline: UK BRC August retail sales survey - Table.

text.p: The British Retail Consortium published the following data on UK retail sales value in August (annual percentage changes):
(NOTE - BRC says like-for-like figures will in general provide a more accurate guide to spending patterns, removing the effect of expansion in retail floor space on sales).

NOTE - The Retail Sales Monitor measures changes in actual value of retail sales from a sample of 75 retailers who account for around half total UK retail sales. Figures are re-weighted to remove any bias in the sample towards specific categories of spending. They are not otherwise adjusted for changes in seasonal influences (such as the timing of Easter) or price changes.
